Class AbstractRefreshableApplicationContext

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.core.io.DefaultResourceLoader
org.springframework.context.support.AbstractApplicationContext
org.springframework.context.support.AbstractRefreshableApplicationContext
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, AutoCloseable, BeanFactory, HierarchicalBeanFactory, ListableBeanFactory, ApplicationContext, ApplicationEventPublisher, ConfigurableApplicationContext, Lifecycle, MessageSource, EnvironmentCapable, ResourceLoader, ResourcePatternResolver
Direct Known Subclasses:
AbstractRefreshableConfigApplicationContext
public abstract class AbstractRefreshableApplicationContext extends AbstractApplicationContext
Base class for ApplicationContext implementations which are supposed to support multiple calls to AbstractApplicationContext.refresh(), creating a new internal bean factory instance every time. Typically (but not necessarily), such a context will be driven by a set of config locations to load bean definitions from.

子类需要实现的唯一方法是 loadBeanDefinitions(DefaultListableBeanFactory)，该方法在每次刷新时都会被调用。具体实现应该将 bean 定义加载到给定的 DefaultListableBeanFactory 中，通常通过委托给一个或多个特定的 bean 定义读取器来实现。

请注意，WebApplicationContext 也有一个类似的基类。 AbstractRefreshableWebApplicationContext 提供了相同的子类化策略，但此外还预先实现了所有针对 Web 环境的功能。此外，还有一种预定义的方式来接收 Web 环境的配置位置。

读取特定 Bean 定义格式的该基类的具体独立子类是 `ClassPathXmlApplicationContext` 和 `FileSystemXmlApplicationContext`，它们都源自共同的 `AbstractXmlApplicationContext` 基类；`AnnotationConfigApplicationContext` 支持使用 `@Configuration` 注解的类作为 Bean 定义源。

Since:
1.1.3

Jürgen Hoeller，Chris Beams

      public void setAllowBeanDefinitionOverriding(boolean allowBeanDefinitionOverriding)
      设置是否允许通过注册具有相同名称的不同定义来覆盖 Bean 定义，从而自动替换前者。如果不允许，将抛出异常。默认值为"true"。

      • DefaultListableBeanFactory.setAllowBeanDefinitionOverriding(boolean)

    • setAllowCircularReferences

      public void setAllowCircularReferences(boolean allowCircularReferences)
      Set whether to allow circular references between beans - and automatically try to resolve them.

      默认为"true"。将其关闭以在遇到循环引用时抛出异常，从而完全禁止它们。

      See Also:
      • AbstractAutowireCapableBeanFactory.setAllowCircularReferences(boolean)

      protected final void refreshBeanFactory() throws BeansException

    • closeBeanFactory

      protected final void closeBeanFactory()
      描述从类复制：AbstractApplicationContext
      Subclasses must implement this method to release their internal bean factory. This method gets invoked by AbstractApplicationContext.close() after all other shutdown work.

      不应抛出异常，而应记录关闭失败信息。

      Specified by:
      `closeBeanFactory` 类中的 `AbstractApplicationContext`

    • getBeanFactory

      public final ConfigurableListableBeanFactory getBeanFactory()
      描述从类复制：AbstractApplicationContext
      Subclasses must return their internal bean factory here. They should implement the lookup efficiently, so that it can be called repeatedly without a performance penalty.

      注意：子类在返回内部 Bean 工厂之前，应检查上下文是否仍然处于活动状态。一旦上下文已关闭，通常应认为该内部工厂不可用。

      Specified by:
      `getBeanFactory` 接口 `ConfigurableApplicationContext` 中
      Specified by:
      `getBeanFactory` 类中的 `AbstractApplicationContext`
      Returns:
      该应用程序上下文的内部 Bean 工厂（永远不为null）
      See Also:
      • AbstractApplicationContext.refreshBeanFactory()
      • AbstractApplicationContext.closeBeanFactory()

    • createBeanFactory

      protected DefaultListableBeanFactory createBeanFactory()
      Create an internal bean factory for this context. Called for each AbstractApplicationContext.refresh() attempt.

      默认实现会创建一个`DefaultListableBeanFactory`，其父 bean 工厂为上下文的父对象的内部 bean 工厂。可在子类中重写此方法，例如用于自定义`DefaultListableBeanFactory`的设置。

      Returns:
      该上下文的 BeanFactory
      See Also:
      • DefaultListableBeanFactory.setAllowBeanDefinitionOverriding(boolean)
      • DefaultListableBeanFactory.setAllowEagerClassLoading(boolean)
      • AbstractAutowireCapableBeanFactory.setAllowCircularReferences(boolean)
      • AbstractAutowireCapableBeanFactory.setAllowRawInjectionDespiteWrapping(boolean)

    • customizeBeanFactory

      protected void customizeBeanFactory(DefaultListableBeanFactory beanFactory)
      Customize the internal bean factory used by this context. Called for each AbstractApplicationContext.refresh() attempt.

      默认实现会应用此上下文中指定的 "allowBeanDefinitionOverriding" 和 "allowCircularReferences" 设置。可以在子类中重写它以自定义任何 DefaultListableBeanFactory 的设置。

      Parameters:
      beanFactory - 为此上下文新创建的 BeanFactory
      See Also:
      • DefaultListableBeanFactory.setAllowBeanDefinitionOverriding(boolean)
      • AbstractAutowireCapableBeanFactory.setAllowCircularReferences(boolean)
      • AbstractAutowireCapableBeanFactory.setAllowRawInjectionDespiteWrapping(boolean)
      • DefaultListableBeanFactory.setAllowEagerClassLoading(boolean)
